Ushintsho lwentengo uma luqhathaniswa ne-Bitcoin ezinsukwini ezingu-90.
I-app ibonisa kuphela inani futhi ayikubizi ngokuthi yisizini. Inani livamise ukushintsha ezinsukwini, hhayi emahoreni.

Inani ngalinye liza nomusho owodwa ochaza ukuthi lilinganisani, nokuthi likuphi emlandweni walo kusukela ngo-2016. I-app ayiwahloli amanani futhi ayitholi isigaba semakethe; imikhawulo yama-alamu emakethe yileyo oyisethayo kuphela. Amaphethini adlule akudingeki aziphinde.

Izinkomba ezivamile ze-Bitcoin njengamanani alinganisiwe nje: Mayer Multiple, isilinganiso samaviki angu-200, ukwehla kusuka kokuphezulu kwesikhathi sonke, ushintsho ezinsukwini ezingu-30, igebe le-Pi Cycle namanani e-on-chain i-MVRV, i-Puell Multiple ne-hashrate.
Inani ngalinye liza nomusho owodwa ochaza ukuthi lilinganisani, ngaphandle kokuhlola. Kuma-coin anomlando omfushane wentengo amanye amanani awekho. Idatha ye-on-chain ayifakiwe lapha.

Izinkomba ezifanayo ezilula ze-coin oyikhethayo, kusukela kudatha yentengo kuphela: Mayer Multiple, isilinganiso samaviki angu-200, ukwehla kusuka kokuphezulu kwesikhathi sonke, ushintsho ezinsukwini ezingu-30, umkhuba wezinsuku ezingu-50/200, i-RSI namandla uma iqhathaniswa ne-Bitcoin ezinsukwini ezingu-90.

I-halving elandelayo ibalwa kusukela ekuphakameni kwe-block kwamanje nesikhathi esimaphakathi se-block senkathi ye-difficulty yamanje (mempool.space); ngaphandle kwaleyo datha, ngekhalenda (i-halving yokugcina kanye neminyaka ecishe ibe mine). Ishadi libonisa indlela yentengo yemijikelezo edlule kusukela ku-halving yayo – umlando, hhayi isibikezelo.

Okuncane kusho ukuthi intengo iseduze nerekhodi layo, okukhulu kusho ukuthi ingaphansi kwalo kakhulu.
Okuphozithivu kusho ukuthi iphezulu kunezinsuku ezingu-30 ezedlule, okunegethivu kusho ukuthi iphansi.
